Name: Apache HTTPd: Range Header DoS
Synopsis: The remote web server is vulnerable to a denial of service attack.
Description: The version of Apache installed on the remote host is affected by a denial of service vulnerability due to how it handles Range headers.
Solution: Upgrade Apache to version 2.2.21 or later.

Name: Apache HTTP Server Slow HTTP DoS
Synopsis: The remote Apache server may be vulnerable to a slow HTTP DoS attack.
Description: The Apache HTTP server on the remote host may be vulnerable to a slow HTTP denial of service attack (Slowloris).
Solution: Upgrade to Apache 2.2.15 or later, or apply workarounds such as mod_reqtimeout.

Name: SSL Version 2 and 3 Protocol Detection
Synopsis: The remote service uses SSL 2.0 or 3.0 (SSLv3).
Description: The remote service accepts connections encrypted using SSL 2.0 or 3.0. These versions have known cryptographic flaws (POODLE, DROWN).
Solution: Disable SSLv2 and SSLv3 and use TLS 1.2 or higher.

Name: Apache Bash Remote Code Execution (Shellshock)
Synopsis: The remote web server is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.
Description: The remote host is running a version of Bash that is vulnerable to the Shellshock bug. An attacker can exploit this to execute arbitrary commands on the remote host.
Solution: Update Bash to the latest version available from the OS vendor.

Name: OpenSSL Heartbleed Information Disclosure
Synopsis: The remote service is affected by an information disclosure vulnerability.
Description: The remote service is vulnerable to the OpenSSL Heartbleed vulnerability. An attacker can exploit this to expose sensitive information from the server's memory, including private keys and passwords.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to version 1.0.1g or later and regenerate all SSL certificates and private keys.
Plugin Output:
OpenSSL version: 1.0.1e

Name: SSH Server CBC Mode Ciphers Enabled
Synopsis: The SSH server is configured to allow CBC mode ciphers.
Description: The SSH server is configured to support Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) encryption, which may allow an attacker to recover the plaintext message from the ciphertext.
Solution: Disable CBC mode ciphers and use CTR or GCM mode ciphers instead.

Name: MS17-010: EternalBlue SMB Remote Code Execution
Synopsis: A critical remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft SMBv1.
Description: The remote Windows host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability in the SMBv1 server. WannaCry and NotPetya ransomware exploited this flaw.
Solution: Apply Microsoft patch MS17-010 immediately. Also disable SMBv1.

Name: MS12-020: Remote Desktop Protocol Remote Code Execution
Synopsis: A critical vulnerability exists in Microsoft's Remote Desktop Protocol.

Solution: Apply Microsoft patch MS12-020 immediately.
Plugin Output: RDP is running on port 3389 and the system is unpatched.

Name: MySQL Authentication Bypass
Synopsis: An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in MySQL.
Description: The version of MySQL running on the remote host is vulnerable to an authentication bypass. Under certain conditions, a user can gain access without knowing the correct password.
Solution: Upgrade MySQL to version 5.1.63, 5.5.24, or 5.6.6 or later.
